_comment: Compressed on-disk size of the release APK, in bytes. Re-armed 2026-09-15 at 2309621 bytes (+98.4 KiB over the previous 2208905). The growth is the reader chrome in 238a549: the first use in the app of Material 3's Slider and Surface (the seek bar and page indicator, §5.2), which R8 now keeps; the tap-zone commit just before it was within the gate. Material 3 is the §7 design system and the settings screen (PR #15) uses the same Slider, so this is intended growth, not dependency bloat. Verified reproducible: a local :app:assembleRelease produced exactly the size CI measured. The gate fails past 2% or 64 KiB over this, whichever is larger. Regenerate deliberately with: python3 tools/check-apk-size.py --apk app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk --update
